propositions: The mapping seam requires authoritative documentation of the [tool.rebar.mapping] configuration surface, merge layers, axis catalog, and per-project keying
Mapping seam capabilities must be provider-neutral and exercisable without requiring specific CI providers or live Jira integration
The feature is additive and backward-compatible; absence of [tool.rebar.mapping] section reproduces current hardcoded behavior exactly
Rollback is safe and achieved by deleting the [tool.rebar.mapping] section with no store migration required
A mapping-seam guide must document the provider-neutral core as the reuse seam for future integration targets (Linear, GitLab, GitHub-Issues)
Portability is substantiated by injected-transport unit tests with no live Jira or CI provider dependency
